resource.title: Fundamentals of Business Process Management 配套网站（Marlon Dumas, Marcello La Rosa, Jan Mendling, Hajo A. Reijers；免费提供 slides 与视频讲座）
resource.covers: 站点原文说明：'In this website you will find slides and video lectures, figures and other supplementary material associated with the book'，并交代第二版结构：'extended and completely revised chapters on process identification, process discovery, qualitative process analysis, process redesign, process automation and process monitoring. We also added a new chapter on BPM as an enterprise capability'——正好覆盖流程发现、建模/分析、重设计、自动化与持续监控改进这条主线。

courses.prereq_text: Prerequisite(s): BUS-K303 or BUS-K304 (honors) with a grade of C or higher

notes: 原图建议前置 I.1.1 在 Penn State 得到硬性支持（MIS 420 直接要求 MIS 390 Foundations of Information Systems）。Kelley 的 BUS-K 315 要求的是 BUS-K303/K304（Kelley 的信息技术基础课，我未能核实其具体课程内容，故 mapped_ids 留空，不给节点映射，也不写进 extra_prereqs）。课程主页原文还写到课程目标 'learn how information technology is used to enable and manage business processes'，与节点'流程执行与自动化'一致。资源侧：该配套站是 BPM 教材的官方课件中心（slides + 视频），站点本身没有逐章目录，故只按首页原文声明覆盖范围，未逐页打开讲义。
